boundary: Missing price does not mean unavailable or free.

claim: Products retained by price + description + features filter
boundary: Eligibility changes are measurable; conversion effects are unknown.
Exact records only; repeated short phrases are not evidence of fraud.
Parent-level match does not establish variant-level attribute agreement.

claim: Reviewers with one distinct observed product
boundary: Category-specific observed reviews are not complete purchase histories.

claim: Reviewers with at least five distinct observed products
boundary: Earlier eligible histories after a temporal split will be fewer.

claim: Products with >=20 deduplicated reviews and >=3 low and >=3 high ratings
boundary: Candidate pool only; neither preference conflicts nor customer fit are validated.

claim: Raw reviews with variant ASIN different from parent ASIN
boundary: Identifier difference alone is not a join error.

claim: Five-star products supported by fewer than five catalog ratings
boundary: Catalog ratings and collected reviews have different scopes.
